summary: All four round-1 majors are closed. Terminate-all-sessions has both happy-path (asserts API call shape, store-clear, navigation) and error-path (asserts terminate-error renders and navigateTo NOT called). Modal consequences list is asserted with three regex matches (проект/бот/підписник) covering all three list items. Change-password gains three new error-path tests — empty-current, weak-new (no digit), and backend-400 — and the 400 test correctly asserts the request body is { currentPassword, newPassword } without confirmPassword. Email read-only is pinned by both the readonly attribute and the value mirror. Name edit flow exercises click→type→submit and asserts PATCH body, store mutation, and the name-saved indicator. The data-test="name-edit-form" addition to profile.vue is justified (commit message documents the happy-dom button-click→form-submit limitation). All new tests pass the litmus test: removing the corresponding implementation line breaks the assertion. Test count grew from 8 to 12 in profile.spec.ts as expected. Two minor cleanups from round 1 remain (cargo-culted setActivePinia in both files; useState('auth-user') line in dashboard.spec.ts; mock-shape comment added to profile.spec.ts but not dashboard.spec.ts) — none affect correctness, all are noise. NOTE: vitest run was blocked by sandbox; static analysis only — orchestrator should confirm green suite separately.

findings.issue: Round-1 minor (cargo-culted setActivePinia + useState('auth-user') = null) is partially addressed: profile.spec.ts gained a clarifying comment explaining why the plain-object mock is sufficient, but dashboard.spec.ts still calls setActivePinia(createPinia()) on line 29 and useState<unknown>('auth-user').value = null on line 31. Neither line affects test behavior because useAuthStore is fully mocked via mockNuxtImport. Pure noise that confuses future readers.
